_readme: Decision 600: the owner's site's estimated track assignment (rail-3d/physical/dispatch.json) of every Taiwan Railway, High Speed Rail and forest railway train. paths: each path from a station to the next, as [way, from point, to point] of rail_tracks.json's ways, in the order it runs; plans: each train's system (s), number (n), first departure and last arrival seconds (k), stations (t, of stations), whether it calls at each (q), the path between each two (p, of paths), and x when no other train may borrow its paths. An estimate, not the railway's own. Made by tools/real-railways/extract_tracks.py; do not edit.
